name: Chaos Engineering Scenarios for Activities
description: Intentionally break activities to test fault detection and recovery

scenarios.name: Invalid Input Data Scenario
scenarios.description: Provide malformed or unexpected input to activities

test_cases.expected_behavior: Activity should throw TypeError with descriptive message
test_cases.recovery_strategy: Validate inputs at activity entry, provide default fallback

test_cases.expected_behavior: Activity should exit gracefully with 'no files to process' message
Activity should catch JSON parse error and report
test_cases.recovery_strategy: Wrap JSON.parse in try-catch, validate structure

scenarios.name: Missing Dependencies Scenario
scenarios.description: Remove required files or tools during execution

test_cases.expected_behavior: Activity should detect missing file and report error
test_cases.recovery_strategy: Check file existence before read, provide helpful error message

test_cases.expected_behavior: Activity should fail gracefully with tool availability error
test_cases.recovery_strategy: Check tool availability before use, suggest alternatives

scenarios.name: Timeout and Performance Scenarios
scenarios.description: Trigger timeout or slow execution conditions

test_cases.expected_behavior: Activity should timeout gracefully and report partial progress
test_cases.recovery_strategy: Implement progress tracking, allow resume from checkpoint

test_cases.expected_behavior: Activity should detect invalid iteration count

scenarios.name: Resource Exhaustion Scenarios
scenarios.description: Exhaust memory, disk, or other resources

test_cases.expected_behavior: Activity should respect impulse budgets and fail safely
test_cases.recovery_strategy: Enforce hard limits on impulse budgets, implement streaming

test_cases.expected_behavior: Activity should detect disk space issues and report
test_cases.recovery_strategy: Check available disk space before writing large outputs

scenarios.name: Concurrent Execution Conflicts
scenarios.description: Run multiple activities concurrently on same files

test_cases.expected_behavior: Activities should coordinate or fail gracefully
test_cases.recovery_strategy: Implement file locking or detect concurrent modifications

test_cases.expected_behavior: Activity should detect spec changes and abort or adapt
test_cases.recovery_strategy: Version specifications, detect changes via checksum

scenarios.name: Malicious Input Injection
scenarios.description: Attempt code injection or path traversal

test_cases.expected_behavior: Activity should reject path traversal attempts
test_cases.recovery_strategy: Validate paths are within expected directory, sanitize inputs

test_cases.expected_behavior: Activity should escape shell commands properly
test_cases.recovery_strategy: Use parameterized commands, never interpolate untrusted input

steps: Categorize fault type (input, dependency, timeout, etc.)
Store fault report with full context
Identify fix pattern (add validation, improve error handling, etc.)
Ensure no regressions on normal inputs
Roll back if failure rate exceeds threshold
